_schema.purpose: Which game features an account has unlocked, so the task queue can skip work that cannot succeed. Read by core/capability.py and scripts/capability_report.py.

entry.label: human name, shown in the report
entry.conditions: list of {state_key, op, value}; ALL must hold. A condition whose state_key is unreadable evaluates UNKNOWN and FAILS OPEN (the task runs).
entry.source: list of URLs the value came from
entry.last_verified: YYYY-MM-DD; the report flags entries older than 180 days as STALE
entry.notes: disputes, version dependence, anything a reader needs

_schema.disputed_values_rule: Where sources disagree, encode the LOWEST claimed threshold. The gate then skips only when the account is below every source's number, so a dispute can never cause a false skip.
_schema.researched: 2026-09-02, community sources. Community data is not ground truth: run scripts/capability_report.py and check it against the game before trusting a skip.
_schema.mapping: Tasks declare which feature they need via TaskSpec.gate in Main/task_menu.py. tests/test_capability.py asserts every declared key resolves to a feature here or is the ALWAYS/UNKNOWN sentinel.
_schema.observed_locks: Buildings that are not yet unlocked are ABSENT from the UI rather than shown locked -- verified live 2026-09-03 for Beast Cage, Arena and Labyrinth at Furnace 7. So the observed-lock path (core/player_profile.record_lock) fires only for STATE-based locks like VIP, which is a purchasable status rather than an unbuilt building. Do not 'fix' the lock detection on the assumption it is broken for buildings; there is nothing on screen to read.

exploration.label: Exploration / Hero Hall
exploration.notes: Two independent sources agree. Hero Hall and Explorer's Cabin both open at 4.

infantry_camp.label: Infantry Camp (troop training)
infantry_camp.notes: The train() task runs all three troop types. Gated on the EARLIEST camp so it runs and trains what it can: Marksman is F8 and Lancer F9.

alliance.label: Alliance (join / tech / chests / triumph)
alliance.notes: Joining opens at 7; creating costs 400 gems until F10. Being IN an alliance is a separate fact the bot cannot read yet — profile alliance.name is still the seed literal 'xxx'.

arena_of_glory.label: Arena of Glory
arena_of_glory.notes: DISPUTED: building at F8 (whiteoutdata) vs mode at F10 (ajackof). Encoded at 8 per the disputed-values rule, so an F8-F9 account runs it rather than being wrongly skipped. OBSERVED LIVE 2026-09-03 at Furnace 7: the Daily Missions list has no Arena row. The feature is ABSENT from the UI, not displayed with a lock marker, so read_lock_marker() finds nothing and no observed lock can ever be recorded for it. The static gate is the only thing holding this.

infirmary.label: Infirmary (healing)
infirmary.notes: The Clinic opens earlier at F4; the Infirmary that heals wounded troops is F8.

beast_cage.label: Pets (Beast Cage)
beast_cage.notes: COMPOSITE. state_age_days is not readable today, so that half evaluates UNKNOWN and fails open; the furnace half still decides below 18. Sources give 55-60 days; 60 used. OBSERVED LIVE 2026-09-03 at Furnace 7: the Pet icon is not on the home screen at all (tap_on_template('Home.Pet') returns None). The feature is ABSENT from the UI, not displayed with a lock marker, so read_lock_marker() finds nothing and no observed lock can ever be recorded for it. The static gate is the only thing holding this.

labyrinth.label: Labyrinth
labyrinth.notes: COMPOSITE, and the only entry with an OFFICIAL source. command_center_level is not readable today so it fails open. Also opens no earlier than the Monday of the 4th week after the state opens. OBSERVED LIVE 2026-09-03 at Furnace 7: the Daily Missions list has no Labyrinth row. The feature is ABSENT from the UI, not displayed with a lock marker, so read_lock_marker() finds nothing and no observed lock can ever be recorded for it. The static gate is the only thing holding this.

daybreak_island.label: Life Essence (Daybreak Island)
daybreak_island.notes: Single source. The dock to the island is the gate.

embassy.label: Embassy
embassy.notes: The building is solidly F8, but whether SENDING alliance help requires it or merely scales with it is unverified — so alliance_help is deliberately left UNKNOWN rather than gated on this.

alliance_mobilization.label: Alliance Mobilization
alliance_mobilization.notes: COMPOSITE. Furnace 10 is official; the 15-member figure is community-sourced and the official FAQ says only that the alliance must 'meet the requirements'. No task maps here yet.

_unverified_gates._comment: Research record: tasks whose gate could NOT be verified on 2026-09-02. They declare the UNKNOWN sentinel in Main/task_menu.py and never skip. Recorded so nobody re-researches them.
_unverified_gates.vip: No furnace gate found. Claiming VIP daily rewards needs active VIP status, which is a different axis entirely.
_unverified_gates.free_claims: Not a single feature; the home-screen dots are several unrelated surfaces.
_unverified_gates.alliance_help: Embassy (F8) gates the NUMBER of ally assists; whether it gates sending help at all is unverified.
_unverified_gates.gather: No explicit gate on world-map gathering. Secured Alliance Gathering Nodes need F16, but ordinary nodes appear ungated.
_unverified_gates.anchor_drift: A diagnostic task in this repo, not a game feature. Never gated.
